name: Rising Odds
storyline:
Ten people are kidnapped by a strange individual named "The Host", forcing them to play the game of "Rising Odds". The rules are simple, when the countdown hits zero, only one participant chosen at random will be able to leave this place.

To make things more interesting, the Host also gave each participant a unique "gift", which could be used to save someone in need, to defend themselves or... to fulfill a purpose far more sinister.
Will the participants rely on their good fortune and cooperate with each other? Or will they create better odds for themselves?

You did not ask to play this game.
Nevertheless, you are trapped in this abandoned prison and will fight to survive. Will you discover the truth behind this game? Who is behind it? But most importantly, how to escape this place alive?
summary: Participate in the Death Game "Rising Odds", a psychological horror visual novel, with dark and gore themes. Your choices will decide how this story ends!
